note: Authored game dialogue for fictional characters. The Bednar character's lines are NOT real quotes. Fall 1999: no new university name appears here (team decision 22).

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Thank you for coming. Our college is growing, and our students will need more great teachers.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Four faculty candidates are waiting in Personnel Services, just down the hall: math, English, art and engineering.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Walk each one over to their department for a teaching demonstration, then come back for the next. Please take the art candidate before the engineering candidate; that's how the departments scheduled them. When all four are done, report to me.

reminder: Candidates still to hire: {list}. They wait in Personnel Services, down the hall.
readyReminder: All four are hired? Wonderful — tell me about them.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: Math, English, art and engineering, all hired. And I hear the art studio's projector works again.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: These teachers will bless many students. Well done.

greetings.math: Hi! I'm due in the Romney Building to teach the computer science students. They're stuck on binary — I have an idea from Alma 11.
greetings.english: Hello. My demonstration is in the Smith Building — a student's write-up needs a careful red pen.
greetings.art: Hi there! My demo is up in the old Spori's art studio. I'll be teaching the grid method.
greetings.engineering: Ready when you are. I'm demonstrating in the Austin Building's electronics lab.

waiting.engineering: I'm scheduled after the art candidate. Come get me once the art demo is done.

busy: You're already walking the {other} over. Come back for me after that!
arrive: Lead the way — the {building} is marked on your map.

math: I tried this lesson on my little brother. He's eight. He got it in five minutes.
Fun fact: a limnah is exactly a shum, a seon and a senine. That's my whole hook.
english: Brother Price wrote the summary himself. I hope he doesn't mind a little red ink.
Rule one of editing: check the facts against a source. Rule two: be kind about it.
art: The Spori's art studio has a wonderful old overhead projector. I'm counting on it today.
The grid method is simple: one square at a time, and don't panic.
engineering: I brought a whole lesson on circuits. Let's see if I get to use it.
A short circuit is just electricity taking the lazy way home. That's my favourite thing to explain.

othersWait: Walk me over, and then come back here for the next candidate.

waitingOutside.math: Over here! Ready when you are.
waitingOutside.english: There you are! Shall we head in?
waitingOutside.art: Hi! The studio's on the third floor.
waitingOutside.engineering: Did the art demo finish? Let's go fix that projector.

backFor: Head back to Personnel Services in the Kimball Building for the next candidate.
notHere: Our candidate isn't here yet. They're waiting in Personnel Services in the Kimball Building.
